name: filter_invygo_car (PRODUCTION)
description: Searches the live Invygo fleet across Subscribe-to-Own, Monthly, and Short-Term (daily/weekly) plans by city (mandatory), plan, brand/model, budget, body type, color and condition. Returns matching cars plus a status the agent uses to decide how to respond.
function_description: Search the Invygo car inventory. Always pass the user's city (mandatory) and the plan you handle (product). Optionally pass a specific brand/model (query), the user's budget (max_price), body_type, color, or condition. Use 'tier' ONLY for explicit luxury/segment requests. The response includes a 'status' field, a 'results' array, and helpful hints (e.g. also_in_cities, also_in_products, price_min/price_max).

city.description: The pickup/service city. MANDATORY. Must be one of the listed cities.

product.description: The subscription plan to search: STO (Subscribe to Own), MONTHLY (monthly subscription), or STS (short-term daily/weekly rental). Send the plan THIS agent handles.

query.description: A specific brand or model ONLY (e.g. 'Toyota', 'Yaris', 'Camry'). Do NOT put body types ('SUV','Sedan'), tiers, or colors here.

max_price.description: The user's budget in Saudi Riyals. Monthly amount for STO/MONTHLY; weekly amount for STS (optional for STS).

min_price.description: Optional LOWER price bound for a range request (e.g. 'between 1500 and 2500' -> min_price 1500). Same basis as max_price. Leave empty unless the user gives a floor.

min_year.description: Optional minimum model year (e.g. '2024 or newer' -> 2024). Cars older than this are excluded. Leave empty unless the user asks for a minimum year.

body_type.description: Physical body shape. Infer from the model when possible (e.g. Yaris->Sedan, Creta->SUV, Hilux->Pickup). Used for recommendations/alternatives.

tier.description: ONLY for explicit segment/luxury requests. Use a specific tier (e.g. 'Midsize Sedan', 'Luxury SUV') or the generic 'Luxury' for any luxury car. Leave empty for normal searches and for alternative recommendations.

condition.description: Only set if the user explicitly asks for a New or Used car.
